questions.text: What does Daniyal study at WKU?
questions.hint: "My name is Daniyal Sultanov. I study Law at WKU — it is my first year."

questions.text: The weather was cold and rainy on Daniyal's great day.
questions.hint: "The weather was sunny and surprisingly warm for October — the sky was clear and blue." — Daniyal.

questions.text: How long was Daniyal in the library after his lecture?
questions.hint: "After the lecture, I was in the university library for two hours." — Daniyal.

questions.text: When the judges announced the result, Daniyal's team was the ___.
questions.hint: "When the judges announced the result, my team was the winner." — the best moment of Daniyal's day.

questions.text: Why was Ainur's morning a disaster?
opts: She missed the bus to WKU
She forgot her textbooks at home
She was sick and had a fever
Her alarm was broken and she was soaking wet in the rain
questions.correct: Her alarm was broken and she was soaking wet in the rain
questions.hint: "My alarm clock was broken — it was silent all night." + "There was a strong wind and it was raining. My umbrella was at home in Kostanay. I was wet, cold, and hungry." — Ainur.

questions.text: Ainur was well-prepared for the unexpected quiz in her second lecture.
questions.hint: "I was completely unprepared — I was sure the quiz was scheduled for Friday, not Monday." — Ainur.

questions.text: Who helped Ainur at the end of her difficult day?
questions.hint: "My roommate Gulnara was there — she was kind and caring. She made a big cup of tea for both of us." — Ainur.

questions.text: At lunch, what were the problems Ainur faced in the cafeteria?
opts: It was closed and she was hungry
The food was too spicy and expensive
It was crowded, the soup was cold, there was no bread, and she was alone
Her friends were rude and left without her
questions.correct: It was crowded, the soup was cold, there was no bread, and she was alone
questions.hint: "The cafeteria was crowded. The soup was already cold and there was no bread left. I was alone because my friends were at a different lecture." — Ainur.

questions.text: Where do Daniyal and Ainur meet at the start of the conversation?
questions.hint: They meet "in the corridor" on Tuesday morning and start comparing their very different Mondays.

questions.text: Daniyal says the weather on his Monday was cold, rainy, and windy.
questions.hint: "Mine was actually great! The weather was sunny and warm all day." — Daniyal. It was AINUR's day that was cold and rainy.

questions.text: Ainur was almost ___ minutes late to her Anatomy lecture.
questions.hint: "No — I was almost ten minutes late! My alarm clock was broken." — Ainur tells Daniyal.

questions.text: Why were Ainur's friends not at lunch with her?
opts: They were at the Debate Club
They were asleep in the dormitory
They were all busy at a different lecture
questions.correct: They were all busy at a different lecture
questions.hint: "No — they were all busy. I was alone." — Ainur explains to Daniyal why she was at lunch by herself.

questions.text: Daniyal says he was confident and calm from the very start of the debate.
questions.hint: "I was very nervous at first, but once I started speaking, I was fine." — Daniyal. He WAS nervous at first.

questions.text: How long was Ainur in the library in the afternoon?
questions.hint: "Yes, for three whole hours. I was exhausted but I was determined to finish my notes." — Ainur.

questions.text: "The weather ___ sunny and the sky ___ clear and blue all day."
questions.hint: "Weather" = it (singular) → WAS. "Sky" = it (singular) → WAS. Both are singular nouns → both take WAS.

questions.text: "My friends were all busy during lunchtime" is correct English.
questions.hint: "Friends" = they = plural → WERE. ✅ "My friends WERE all busy." — Ainur tells Daniyal. Plural nouns always take WERE.

questions.text: "The cafeteria ___ crowded — every table was full and the queue was very long."
questions.hint: "Cafeteria" = it = singular → WAS. "The cafeteria WAS crowded." ✅

questions.text: "___ your team the winner, Daniyal?" — "Yes, we were!"
questions.hint: "Your team" = it = singular → WAS. "WAS your team the winner?" ✅ (not "were your team" — team is one unit)

questions.text: Ainur speaks about the quiz: "The questions ___ very difficult — I ___ not ready at all."
questions.hint: "Questions" = they = plural → WERE ✅. "I" = singular → WAS ✅. "The questions WERE difficult. I WAS not ready."

questions.text: "I weren't ready for the quiz" is correct English.
questions.hint: "I" takes WAS / WASN'T — never WERE / WEREN'T! → "I WASN'T ready." ✅ "weren't" is only for you/we/they.

questions.text: "Was the Constitutional Law lecture interesting?" — "Yes, it ___!"
questions.hint: Short answer to "Was it...?" → "Yes, it WAS." ✅ Never repeat the adjective — just subject + was.

questions.text: Which sentence is correct?
opts: There were a quiz in the second lecture.
There was an unexpected quiz in the second lecture.
There were the quiz on Monday.
questions.correct: There was an unexpected quiz in the second lecture.
questions.hint: "A quiz" = one = singular → "There WAS a quiz." ✅ (not "there were a quiz" — quiz is singular!)

questions.text: What does "outstanding" mean?
opts: very strict and serious with students
extremely tired after a long day
extremely good, clearly better than others
questions.correct: extremely good, clearly better than others
questions.hint: "Dr. Akhanov was outstanding yesterday — his explanations were clear and his stories were truly fascinating." — Daniyal.

questions.text: "Miserable" means feeling very happy and excited about something.
questions.hint: "Miserable" = feeling very UNHAPPY and uncomfortable. "Ainur was alone in the crowded cafeteria — she felt truly miserable." The opposite of happy.

questions.text: Ainur's notes from the lecture were ___ because she arrived ten minutes late.
questions.hint: "Incomplete" = not finished, missing some parts. "My notes from Monday's anatomy lecture were incomplete because I was late." — Ainur.

questions.text: What does "stern" mean?
questions.hint: "Dr. Seitkali's face was stern — she was not happy that Ainur was late." Stern = строгий / суровый.

questions.text: What is "companionship"?
opts: the feeling of friendship and comfort from being with someone
a quiet room for studying alone
questions.correct: the feeling of friendship and comfort from being with someone
questions.hint: "That moment of quiet companionship was the best part of the entire day." — Ainur about sitting with Gulnara over tea.

questions.text: "Determined" means giving up easily when things get difficult.
questions.hint: "Determined" = having a STRONG wish to do something and NOT giving up. "I was frustrated and tired. But I was also determined." — Ainur in the library.

questions.text: Ainur had no umbrella, so she was ___ wet when she arrived at WKU.
questions.hint: "Soaking wet" = промокший насквозь — completely wet all the way through. "I was soaking wet!" — Ainur.

questions.text: What does "content" mean?
opts: very excited and full of energy
quietly happy and satisfied with your situation
questions.correct: quietly happy and satisfied with your situation
questions.hint: "After the phone call, Daniyal was tired but content — it was a good day." Content = доволен / умиротворённый.
